asr.full_text: Hello and welcome to another update video on DOT. We want to take a look at the Polkarot chart on the shorter time frame, just for a little bit of context for anybody who is not so much aware of our larger time frame view, which by the way hasn't really changed over the last year or so, because, well, it's been even more bearish than even I thought, even though I have been quite clear on the bearish potential for DOT. But it has not even been able to give us a larger bounce. Which I still thought might be at least likely. Possibly even towards the $9 to $10 area. It can still happen. But I do not see all-time highs. And bear in mind it would only be part of a corrective rally. Now I can of course be wrong. I can of course be wrong, I can of course be wrong about it but I have to say that the potential is rather bearish on this chart. A bounce can always happen but a rally to all-time highs would, well, not surprise me, rather impress me because nothing should be surprising and crypto. I think that's a healthy perspective, but we can only focus on what the market is. And what the trend is doing and the trend is down and we can identify the resistances that need to be broken to eliminate, not eliminate, but to reduce the risk of further downside. Yeah, at least to indicate that a larger bounce is unfolding. Because if you're hoping for recovery, I mean, there are people who, you know, have been saying that DOT is bullish. Lots of influencers and still highlighting how DOT has to go to ultimate highs and everything. But they've been doing that for the last few years and the trend is just down, guys. You can always become bullish when the market is moving, but it's not turning. It's not turning and the trend is still down. So we just align ourselves with price action. If the price does something different tomorrow we can start to sketch higher prices, then there might be a set up for it, but for now the trend is down. Looking at the short time frame for dot you see we could be in a third wave to the downside there is a potential though that this is just an overshooting b wave to the downside which could lead to a corrective rally towards 660 and 1050 okay so looking at the larger time frame yeah you see see this is sort of that resistance area. And if we go lower, we could still do that even in the white scenario for an over shooting B wave to the downside but below 2.26, the yellow scenario, sorry, the orange scenario will be even more likely and white will become even less likely because that level at 2.26 is kind of the theoretical maximum that white wave B should do, okay? It's not an invalidation point, B waves can even go lower especially in a very bearish situation, but it's less likely then, yeah? Now, in the very short term, we could have at any point now get a bounce into this resistance area, maybe after a few more squiggles to the downside, 3.44- 4.36 is resistance, only a break above would indicate that some kind of recovery might be underway. That's the update on DOT, hope you liked the update! If you did please hit the like button, leave a comment and subscribe. If you're interested in additional updates, make sure to check out our membership! Thank you so much! Bye bye!
